label: PGA Min Envelope Value
description: Filter PGA events with envelope_value (linear broadband contrast envelope value at the peak frame, computed by the percentile-gated detector's find_peaks call) below the threshold. The envelope_value is a per-event diagnostic stamped on every event alongside prominence; it tracks the absolute height of the peak in the contrast-summed attack envelope, while prominence tracks the peak's vertical distance to the local contour line. Sister filter to pga_min_prominence: envelope_value drops events whose peak didn't reach a minimum absolute level (catches the very-low-energy FPs that the prominence filter sometimes misses on the rising edge of a strike), while prominence drops events whose peak is short relative to its immediate neighbors. Both are useful; envelope_value is a better 'is this a real strike at all' test, prominence is a better 'is this a clean isolated strike' test. Default 1000 catches the floor — real toms / snare / hihat / cymbals strikes produce envelope_value in the 5000-15000 range on the calibrated projects, FPs and low-energy noise are typically < 3000. Set to 0 to disable.
